tactical.explanation: State owned by ext-claude-cli; the only writer is the `claude mcp add` shell-out. es-view holds no in-memory or on-disk store for it. Re-stated here to attach the registration's fields (name/url/scope).

anchors.note: the only writer; effect lands in the external CLI config

fields.name: name
fields.derivation: The registered MCP server alias: the compile-time constant MCP_NAME = 'event-storming' (server.mjs:24), passed as the <name> argument of `claude mcp add`. Fixed, not user-supplied.
fields.notes: The registration's state lives in the user's Claude config (ownedBy ext-claude-cli), written by shelling `claude mcp add` in mcp-register.mjs; es-view reads no store for it, so there is no physical node to cite.

fields.name: url
fields.derivation: The HTTP MCP endpoint registered for the alias: mcpUrl() = runtime.baseUrl + '/mcp' (server.mjs:99), where runtime.baseUrl = `http://<host>:<port>` is set only after the socket binds (server.mjs:204). Uses the ACTUAL bound port, which may fall forward past the default 5178 on EADDRINUSE, so the registered URL agrees with the live server. Quoted in the register command; a 503 is returned if the socket is not yet bound.
fields.notes: In-memory only (runtime.baseUrl); the durable copy lands in the external Claude config via `claude mcp add`. Not a store es-view reads.

fields.name: scope
fields.derivation: Which store in the user's Claude config the entry lands in: one of local | project | user, chosen in the ConnectClaude dropdown. Double-whitelisted: the route accepts scope only if in {local,project,user} else undefined (server.mjs:182), and claudeMcpAdd re-checks the SCOPES set and appends ` --scope <scope>` only on a hit (mcp-register.mjs:14). An undefined scope omits the flag, letting the Claude CLI apply its default.
fields.notes: Selects the external Claude config store (project-local list / shared .mcp.json / user-global settings); es-view does not read it back.

evidence.note: route-level scope whitelist before the call
